coverage.method: Director Compensation table rows from all eight DEF 14As filed 2019-04-03 through 2026-03-23 (fiscal years 2018-2025; 88 rows). The 2026-03-24 DEFR14A is a verbatim re-filing of the 2026 proxy (text diff shows only cover-page changes) and was not double-counted. No 10-K/A Part III or other proxy with a director pay table was filed in the period (EDGAR submissions feed through 2026-08-28). Employee directors (Krzanich, Bryant as Chairman, Swan, Gelsinger, Tan as CEO) are not in the tables. Rows parsed from sec_text output and each quote is the full printed row.

Every NEO in intc_exec_comp_research.json whose officer tenure ended (14 people; Zinsner, Tan and Chandrasekaran remain in office, and Zinsner's interim co-CEO and PAO stints were not exits). Sources: CD&A departure sections, SCT All Other Compensation footnotes and Potential Payments tables of the following proxy, plus 8-K Item 5.02. 10 exits are actual and 4 (Bryant, Rodgers, Johnston Holthaus, Miller Boise) are hypothetical Potential Payments estimates. Broad-based accrued-leave payouts are noted but not counted. The 8-K exhibits with the full separation agreements (Renduchintala, Shenoy) were not read beyond the 8-K text.
